basic_profile.bio: An emerging artist hailing from Brooklyn, recently moved to explore the vibrant art scene in Latvia. Passionate about painting and custom doll making, they spend their days experimenting with new techniques and materials. They often browse Reddit in the late afternoons and evenings, European time. Currently single, they work as a freelance illustrator, which allows them the flexibility to sail on weekends. They dislike cluttered online spaces and enjoy a clean, straightforward browsing experience.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having pursued a degree in Fine Arts at Brooklyn College, they have a solid foundation in traditional painting techniques and art history. Their knowledge is supplemented by self-teaching through online courses and community workshops. Recently developed an interest in sailing, learning primarily through hands-on experience.
